chapters.title: BFS right-to-left, last node wins

frames.caption: BFS right-to-left, last node wins — O(n) time, O(w) extra space. Input: find_bottom_left_value(root=tree (1)). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
node = queue.popleft() — (1) taken from the front of queue
queue.append(node.left) — queue gets (2) appended (... so the leftmost comes out last)
